# Vendored pdf2docx source

- Repository: https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/pdf2docx
- Tag: `v0.5.13`
- Commit: `3e1c2319d6a3fbf2ae4d46c3ab734b7fc87bd9b4`
- Vendored: 2026-10-22
- License: MIT (`LICENSE`)

The upstream repository contents were copied into this directory with their
original relative paths, filenames, and source code. Utilities-specific files
such as `worker.py`, `WORKER.md`, `requirements.in`, `requirements.lock`, and
`tests/` are maintained alongside the upstream tree.

To audit the vendored source against the recorded revision, clone the upstream
repository at the commit above and compare its tracked files with this
directory, excluding the Utilities-specific files and the appended
Utilities-worker entries in `.gitignore`.
